decisions.rationale: Verified: the legacy collections-module-check blueprint records durationMinutes 45 and instructions splitting Part 1 at 15 minutes and Part 2 coding at 30 minutes; the accepted time plan (time-budget-recommendation.md, Collections/Streams row) records the course final as a 90-minute practical plus a 40-minute MCQ. The pre-revision section 3 called the practical the unchanged Part 2 and the 15-item/15-minute Part 1 the existing MCQ component, contradicting section 7. Fix must achieve: every place in the record that defines the practical sources only its coding tasks from the legacy blueprint and states the 90-minute accepted duration, marks the legacy 15/30 split as the superseded intake F28 calendar-block plan, names the accepted 40-minute MCQ as the component the 60-minute final replaces, and leaves the legacy blueprint unedited. Revised file (sha256 e6644859d792d5230c5724fca721d5cf60e95b42f04c93773b4b29510e773a1c): section 3 line 56 and lines 64-65 now do all of this, section 7 line 196 corrects the earlier 30-minute figure, and the legacy blueprint is untouched. Remaining gap: the section 10 taxonomy row (line 252), which the critic's recommendation named explicitly, still reads only 'the coding part of collections-module-check' with no 90-minute duration, so the workbook owner is still pointed at a file whose only practical timing is 30 minutes. Met: no. Closing it needs only that row to say the practical uses the legacy blueprint's coding tasks and runs 90 minutes per the accepted time plan.

Verified against intake.md Day-block allocation: F25 116 + F26 120 + F27 114 + F28 120 = 470 of 480 minutes, so 10 are unallocated; the only assessment time is F28's 45-minute Module check block; the intake Lab plan budgets 47 + 45 = 92 lab minutes against the time plan's 2 x 30 = 60, and the intake has no mastery-check minutes. Verified against the time plan: 225 + 60 + 30 + 130 + 35 = 480, and with the 60-minute final MCQ 225 + 60 + 30 + 150 = 465, using 20 of 35 reserve; 150 - 45 = 105 extra assessment minutes against 10 free. The pre-revision text framed this only as a 45-minute block mismatch. Fix must achieve: restate the conflict as the intake's day blocks leaving 10 free minutes against 105 extra assessment minutes plus the 92-vs-60 lab gap, scope the 465/480 figure to the time plan's allocation, require the course owner to re-plan existing F25-F28 blocks to that allocation without cutting coverage, repurposing the module-check block or adding hours, and mirror this in the section 9 open decision. Revised file (sha256 e6644859d792d5230c5724fca721d5cf60e95b42f04c93773b4b29510e773a1c): section 7 lines 198-203 state all of these figures correctly, scope 465/480 to the time plan, list the target allocation (labs 60, mastery 30, finals 150, reserve 15, summing with content 225 to 480) and keep the no-cut/no-repurpose/no-added-hours constraints; section 9 line 239 now names re-planning F25-F28 to the accepted allocation as the open decision. Met: yes.
